label: Share of soy protein in feed that is imported
label_vi: Tỷ lệ đạm đậu tương nhập khẩu trong thức ăn chăn nuôi
context: In 2025 Vietnam imported 2.61 Mt of soybeans (98.4% of supply) and 5.70 Mt of soybean meal. Domestic crushing uses imported beans, so it does not reduce protein import dependence.

label: Share of maize supply that is imported
label_vi: Tỷ lệ ngô nhập khẩu trong thức ăn chăn nuôi
context: Vietnam imported 11.91 Mt of maize worth USD 2.95 billion in 2025, about 74% of total maize supply, mainly from Argentina and Brazil; domestic output was flat to falling at about 4.1 Mt.

label: Feed-ingredient import bill
label_vi: Kim ngạch nhập khẩu nguyên liệu thức ăn chăn nuôi
context: Our sum of four 2025 customs lines: maize, soybeans, wheat and animal feed and ingredients. It is gross, includes some milling wheat and food soybeans, and is rounded to roughly USD 10 billion in summaries.

label: Livestock and poultry feed output
label_vi: Sản lượng thức ăn chăn nuôi gia súc, gia cầm
context: Industrial livestock and poultry feed, up from 21.5 Mt in 2024. It excludes aquafeed, for which 2025 estimates disagree: 3.9 to 4.8 Mt (industry) against 6.5 Mt (USDA).

label: Seafood exports
label_vi: Kim ngạch xuất khẩu thủy sản
context: Seafood exports rose 12.4% in 2025 and included about USD 4.6 billion of shrimp and USD 2.2 billion of pangasius, much of it raised on imported feed protein.

label: World fishmeal price
label_vi: Giá bột cá thế giới
context: World Bank series for Peruvian fishmeal at 65% protein. August 2026 was 43% above a year earlier and the highest of 2020 to 2026; the 2025 average was USD 1,706 per t.

label: Pork output, live weight
label_vi: Sản lượng thịt lợn hơi
context: Pork output grew 3.9% on 2024, alongside 2.60 Mt of poultry meat (live weight) in 2025. Vietnam is one of Asia's largest producers of animal protein.

label: Livestock share of national greenhouse-gas emissions
label_vi: Tỷ trọng phát thải khí nhà kính của ngành chăn nuôi
context: Enteric fermentation plus manure was 18.5 MtCO2e in the 2016 inventory, against 49.7 MtCO2e from rice. The environmental case rests more on imported feed, manure and antimicrobial use.

label: Cassava roots harvested
label_vi: Sản lượng sắn củ tươi
context: Fresh roots harvested from 499,100 ha in 2025, down 18,600 ha on 2024. Starch factories also process roughly 8 Mt a year of roots imported from Cambodia and Laos.

label: Cassava pulp from starch factories
label_vi: Lượng bã sắn từ các nhà máy tinh bột
context: Our 2025 estimate from Thai factory ratios and Vietnamese starch output: range 4 to 8 Mt wet, about 1.3 Mt dry matter. Pulp holds only 1.5% to 2.6% protein, so it is a carbon source.

label: Cassava starch factories in Tay Ninh
label_vi: Số nhà máy chế biến tinh bột sắn tại Tây Ninh
context: Tay Ninh, which now includes former Long An, has about 6.4 Mt a year of root capacity (2024 to 2025 reports), the largest cassava cluster and the natural site for pulp-based fermentation.

label: Rice bran produced
label_vi: Sản lượng cám gạo
context: Our estimate at 10% of 43.5 Mt of paddy in 2025. Bran is traded, not free: about 1.2 Mt was exported in 2025, mostly to China, and much of the rest goes into domestic feed.

label: Brewer's spent grain, upper bound
label_vi: Lượng bã bia phát sinh tối đa mỗi năm
context: Derived from beer output of 4 to 4.4 billion litres a year (2019 to 2022 reports). It holds only about 32 to 35 kt of protein and spoils within two to three days.

label: Rise in fresh cassava root prices in a year
label_vi: Mức tăng giá sắn củ tươi sau một năm
context: Fresh roots at 30% starch reached VND 3,000 to 3,550 per kg in April 2026, about 75% above April 2025, after a supply shortfall. The E10 fuel-ethanol mandate, in force from June 2026, adds a new buyer.

label: Installed aerobic fermentation volume
label_vi: Tổng thể tích bồn lên men hiếu khí đã lắp đặt
context: Our modelled 2026 estimate from published plant capacities for sterile, aerated tanks. Almost all of it sits inside Vedan, Ajinomoto and Daesang, and none is offered for contract fermentation.

label: Industrial feed mills and their utilisation
label_vi: Số nhà máy thức ăn chăn nuôi và mức khai thác công suất
context: In 2023, 269 mills had 43.2 Mt a year of design capacity; they produced 20.8 Mt in 2022, about 48% utilisation. Spare capacity makes feed trials easy to host.

label: Share of shrimp feed made by six firms
label_vi: Thị phần thức ăn tôm của sáu doanh nghiệp dẫn đầu
context: In 2025 Sheng Long (Haid), C.P., Uni-President, Tongwei, Grobest and Gromax supplied about 640 kt of shrimp feed, so a new feed protein has about six real buyers in shrimp.

label: Soybean crushing capacity of the VAL plant
label_vi: Công suất ép đậu tương của nhà máy VAL
context: Bunge and Wilmar's plant at Phu My, Ho Chi Minh City, after a USD 100 million second line in December 2025, probably design capacity. It crushes imported beans into feed-grade meal only.

label: Median protein in audited plant-based foods
label_vi: Hàm lượng đạm trung vị của sản phẩm chay được khảo sát
context: Across 43 ready-to-eat or ready-to-cook products with a label value in our September 2026 audit of 11 stores; 53% had under 5 g and only 16% reached 10 g.

label: Audited products relying on imported protein
label_vi: Tỷ lệ sản phẩm được khảo sát dùng đạm nhập khẩu
context: Of 170 products in our September 2026 audit whose main protein ingredient could be identified, 77% rely on an imported one and 11% partly do. Soybeans count as imported.

label: China's exports of textured protein to Vietnam
label_vi: Lượng đạm tạo cấu trúc Trung Quốc xuất sang Việt Nam
context: China-reported 2023 exports under HS 2106.10 (protein concentrates and textured protein) at about USD 1.6 per kg, plus 10,028 t of HS 3504 and 10,338 t of gluten. Meat processors also use these.

label: Vinasoy's share of the soy-milk market
label_vi: Thị phần sữa đậu nành của Vinasoy
context: Company or press-reported, not audited. Vinasoy had more than VND 4,100 billion of soy-milk revenue in 2024 and 390 million litres a year of capacity (2022), on imported soybeans.

label: Entobel insect-meal design capacity
label_vi: Công suất thiết kế bột côn trùng của Entobel
context: Black soldier fly meal from a 1,000 t plant in Dong Nai (2019) and a 10,000 t plant in Ho Chi Minh City (2023). Output is not disclosed; insects are a benchmark here, not a play.

label: Vinh Hoan offtake of Entobel insect protein
label_vi: Cam kết bao tiêu đạm côn trùng Entobel của Vĩnh Hoàn
context: Signed in February 2024 by the pangasius exporter: about 5,000 t a year, roughly 45% of Entobel's design capacity. It anchors the only financed alternative-protein plant in Vietnam.

label: Food Safety Law expected before the National Assembly
label_vi: Kỳ họp Quốc hội xem xét Luật An toàn thực phẩm sửa đổi
context: The one near-term window to add a new-food clause. The draft was notified to the WTO in August 2026; the session timing is not yet confirmed on the agenda, and entry into force on 1 January 2027 is possible.

label: Agency time for a new feed-material trial
label_vi: Thời gian xử lý hồ sơ khảo nghiệm thức ăn chăn nuôi mới
context: Protocol approval and result recognition take 15 plus 5 working days each (Circular 94/2025). The trial and annual list update come on top; 6 to 18 months in total is our estimate.

label: Fine for using an unlisted feed raw material
label_vi: Mức phạt khi dùng nguyên liệu ngoài danh mục thức ăn chăn nuôi
context: Under Decree 211/2026, in force since 5 August 2026, plus one to three months' suspension of feed production and destruction of the material. The suspension costs more than the fine.

label: Corporate income tax rate for high-tech projects
label_vi: Thuế suất thu nhập doanh nghiệp ưu đãi cho dự án công nghệ cao
context: Under Law 67/2025, in force from 1 October 2025, high-tech enterprises and projects applying listed high technology also get four years' exemption and nine years at 50%.

label: Novel-food research intensity relative to Thailand
label_vi: Cường độ nghiên cứu thực phẩm mới so với Thái Lan
value: about a quarter to a third of Thailand's
context: Plant-based or cultivated meat records per 10,000 publications, 2015 to September 2026: Vietnam 0.37 against Thailand 1.58 on OpenAIRE, about 23% (our calculation). Edition 1.1 adds OpenAlex: 4.1 against 13.4 core-basket works per 10,000 national publications, 2015 to 2025, about 31%. Counts are lower bounds.

label: Can Tho University places in three core programmes
label_vi: Chỉ tiêu tuyển sinh ba ngành cốt lõi tại Đại học Cần Thơ
context: Places in food technology (300), biotechnology (240) and aquaculture (320) in 2026, within a total quota of 11,850. We could not build a national intake figure.

label: Entobel insect-meal project financing
label_vi: Tổng vốn dự án bột côn trùng Entobel
context: Mekong Capital USD 25 million and Dragon Capital USD 5 million (2022), plus an IFC USD 2.5 million upstream agreement (2023). Earlier drafts said USD 36 million, which is not supported.

label: Venture capital invested in Vietnam
label_vi: Vốn đầu tư mạo hiểm vào Việt Nam
context: Raised across 103 deals in 2025; definitions differ between reports. With no technology IPOs in 2025 or the four years before, exits run through trade sales and buyouts.

label: Agriculture venture capital in Vietnam
label_vi: Vốn đầu tư mạo hiểm vào nông nghiệp tại Việt Nam
context: About 0.2% of the USD 509 million of venture capital raised in Vietnam in 2025. We found no disclosed venture round for a Vietnam-based plant-based or fermentation company.

label: Global alternative-protein investment
label_vi: Vốn đầu tư toàn cầu vào protein thay thế
context: Plant-based USD 450 million, fermentation 357 million and cultivated 74 million in 2025, a cyclical low. Money is shifting towards fermentation and upstream ingredients.

label: Vietnam's regional score on regulatory readiness
label_vi: Điểm sẵn sàng pháp lý của Việt Nam trong khu vực
context: From the October 2025 GFI APAC and Hawkwood Biotech study of nine Asia-Pacific countries. Vietnam scores 100 on labour cost but has no novel-food framework and no approvals.

label: Novel foods approved by Singapore
label_vi: Số thực phẩm mới được Singapore phê duyệt
context: Singapore Food Agency list of 14 August 2026: 6 cultivated meats, 6 fungal or bacterial biomass proteins, 3 precision-fermented ingredients, 2 microalgae and 1 synthetic compound.

label: Cassava starch exports
label_vi: Xuất khẩu tinh bột sắn
context: In 2023, 93.5% went to China. China imported only USD 0.16 million of glucose syrup from Vietnam in 2024, so the starch-to-sugar step that feeds fermentation mostly happens after the starch leaves Vietnam.

label: Food protein ingredient imports
label_vi: Kim ngạch nhập khẩu nguyên liệu đạm thực phẩm
context: Our sum of Vietnam-reported 2023 imports under HS 3504 (USD 22.2 million) and HS 2106.10 (USD 34.0 million). Small next to feed protein imports, and some of it is feed-grade.

label: Labour share of fermentation production cost
label_vi: Tỷ trọng chi phí nhân công trong giá thành lên men
context: In the 2025 regional study's plant models, labour is 7% (biomass) and 17% (precision fermentation) of cost. The models are for a US Midwest plant, not an Asian site.

label: Blended power price for a 24/7 plant
label_vi: Giá điện bình quân cho nhà máy chạy liên tục
context: Our calculation for a 22 kV connection from the tariff in force since May 2025 and the April 2026 peak hours, about USD 0.075. It excludes VAT and any future capacity charge.

label: Monthly minimum wage, Region I
label_vi: Lương tối thiểu vùng I theo tháng
context: From 1 January 2026 under Decree 293/2025, about USD 204. Earlier drafts used the 2024 to 2025 level of VND 4,960,000. Labour is a small share of fermentation cost.

label: Grid emission factor
label_vi: Hệ số phát thải của lưới điện
context: Latest official factor (2023); no official 2024 or 2025 factor was published by September 2026. Power-intensive processes carry a high carbon footprint without renewable supply.

label: Indicative cost of fungal feed protein in Vietnam
label_vi: Giá thành ước tính của đạm nấm cho thức ăn chăn nuôi
context: Our indicative 2026 cost stack for a 10,000 t a year plant, not a feasibility study. Capital charges and maintenance are 54% to 67% of cost; fishmeal protein costs USD 2,625 to 3,846.

label: Fishmeal price per tonne of protein
label_vi: Giá bột cá quy ra mỗi tấn đạm
context: Our calculation at 65% protein from the World Bank series: 2025 average (USD 1,706 per t) and August 2026 (USD 2,500 per t). Soybean meal protein was about USD 880 per t.

label: Indicative cost of textured soy protein
label_vi: Giá thành ước tính của đạm đậu nành tạo cấu trúc
context: Our indicative 2026 cost for a 3,000 t a year extrusion line on imported soy flour or concentrate. It is a small fraction of retail meat and egg protein prices.

label: Retail price of egg and chicken protein
label_vi: Giá bán lẻ đạm từ trứng và thịt gà
value: about 34,000 to 46,000 VND per 100 g protein
context: Online grocery prices in Ho Chi Minh City on 23 September 2026. Eggs and chicken set the floor for mass-market plant-based products; lean pork is about 63,000 to 69,500 VND.

label: Extra cooling cost for fermentation in the tropics
label_vi: Chi phí làm lạnh tăng thêm khi lên men ở vùng nhiệt đới
value: USD 70 to 180 per t dry biomass
context: Our indicative 2026 estimate for southern Vietnam, where cooling water arrives at 31 to 33 °C. It adds about 2% to 4% to fungal feed protein cost; thermotolerant strains avoid most of it.

label: Best precision-fermentation titer vs bulk benchmark
label_vi: Nồng độ protein lên men chính xác tốt nhất so với ngưỡng cần đạt
context: The best published leghemoglobin titers (2022 to 2026) are 3.5, 7.27 and 10.1 g/L, 5 to 15 times below the 50 g/L a leading review says bulk proteins need. That benchmark is an expert assertion.

label: Fishmeal replaced by gas-fermentation protein in shrimp
label_vi: Tỷ lệ bột cá thay được bằng đạm lên men khí trong thức ăn tôm
context: In whiteleg shrimp trials (2022 to 2023), bacterial protein from steel-mill off-gas replaced about 30% of fishmeal without growth loss; at 50% growth fell unless a bile acid was added.

label: Protein quality score (DIAAS) of cooked mung bean
label_vi: Điểm chất lượng đạm DIAAS của đậu xanh nấu chín
context: Measured in pigs on the older child and adult pattern (2020 study). Human digestibility of mung bean in children was about 20% lower. We found no Vietnamese DIAAS study.

label: Cultivated meat cost relative to retail meat
label_vi: Giá thành thịt nuôi cấy so với giá thịt bán lẻ
context: Our calculation: a modelled USD 37 to 51 per kg of wet cells against Vietnamese retail prices of lean pork and chicken breast in September 2026. There is no near-term production case.

label: Plays and public goods assessed
label_vi: Số hướng đi kinh doanh và hàng hóa công được đánh giá
context: Our count from plays.csv (September 2026): ten businesses or programmes, each with conditions, kill tests, first customers and a horizon, plus six public goods that lower the cost of all of them.

label: Leading plays under balanced weights
label_vi: Các hướng đi dẫn đầu theo bộ trọng số cân bằng
context: The cassava-starch-to-sugar hub (T4) and domestic textured plant protein (T1) lead under balanced weights in 2026; T2 and T5 follow at 3.45. Scores are our judgement, not an investment rating.

label: Policy options in the register
label_vi: Số phương án chính sách trong danh mục
context: Our count from policy_options.csv (September 2026): 33 options, of which chapter 12 ranks 24; the other nine earlier options are kept but superseded by more specific ones.

label: Ranked policy options needing low effort
label_vi: Số phương án chính sách đã xếp hạng, dễ triển khai
context: Derived from policy_options.csv: ranked options rated Low effort (a letter, guidance or list update), as of September 2026. The report text does not state this total; ranks 1 to 4 are all low effort.

label: Industrial feed output target for 2030
label_vi: Mục tiêu sản lượng thức ăn chăn nuôi công nghiệp năm 2030
context: Set by the livestock strategy (Decision 1520/2020), against about 22 Mt of livestock and poultry feed in 2025. The texts do not make clear whether the target includes aquafeed.

label: Projected population of Vietnam
label_vi: Dân số Việt Nam dự báo
context: UN medium variant. Population grows only about 5% between 2025 and 2035 and peaks around 2049, so protein demand growth will come mostly from income and diet.

label: Fishmeal to soybean meal price ratio
label_vi: Tỷ lệ giá bột cá so với khô đậu tương
context: From World Bank prices: USD 2,500 against USD 403 per t in August 2026. A ratio sustained above about 5 supports fishmeal replacers; one month's price may revert.

label: Open questions in the register
label_vi: Số câu hỏi còn bỏ ngỏ
context: Our count from open_questions.csv (edition 1.1, September 2026), including 28 added by the futures round. Each question records why it matters, the cheapest way to close it and who to ask; chapter 14 ranks the twenty that matter most.

label: Recorded disagreements between sources
label_vi: Số điểm bất nhất giữa các nguồn
context: Our count from disagreements.csv (edition 1.1, September 2026), including 28 added by the futures round. Each entry gives both claims and the position we took; we never average disagreeing numbers.

label: Sources logged
label_vi: Số nguồn tài liệu đã ghi nhận
context: Our count from sources.csv: 599 sources from wave 1 and 207 from wave 2 (edition 1.0), plus 469 from the futures round (waves 3 to 5, edition 1.1), including press, peer-reviewed papers, company pages, statistics and legal texts. Three rows record our own calculation scripts.

label: Provincial-level units after the 2025 reform
label_vi: Số đơn vị hành chính cấp tỉnh sau sắp xếp năm 2025
context: From 1 July 2025, 28 provinces and 6 centrally governed cities replaced 63 units, and the district tier was abolished. The report uses the new names throughout.

label: Peak working-age population
label_vi: Dân số trong độ tuổi lao động đạt đỉnh
context: People aged 65 and over rise from 9.5% (2025) to 20.0% (2050) of the population; the old-age dependency ratio rises from 14 to 32 per 100. UN World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant.

label: Agricultural emissions cap, 2050
label_vi: Mức trần phát thải nông nghiệp năm 2050
context: Official cap: 64 MtCO2e in 2030 and 56 MtCO2e in 2050, against a 2020 base of 104.5 MtCO2e, the NDC business-as-usual level (46% lower). Official livestock levers are feed rations, manure and biogas, not alternative protein.

label: Mekong Delta subsidence from groundwater pumping
label_vi: Tốc độ sụt lún do khai thác nước ngầm ở ĐBSCL
context: About three times the current rate of global sea-level rise (IPCC AR6: 3.7 mm a year, 2006 to 2018); the delta sits on average about 0.8 m above sea level. Subsidence to 2100 ranges from 12 to 100 cm depending on extraction policy.

label: Chance of a joint maize failure in the four largest exporters
label_vi: Xác suất bốn nước xuất khẩu ngô lớn nhất cùng mất mùa
context: Probability that all four largest maize exporters (87% of world exports) lose more than 10% in the same year: near zero today, 7% at 2 °C of warming (around the 2040s), 86% at 4 °C. Vietnam imports about three-quarters of its maize.

label: Protein from power made in Vietnam, 2050
label_vi: Giá thành đạm từ điện sản xuất tại Việt Nam năm 2050
value: USD 3.3 to 6.5 per kg of protein
context: Our estimate for hydrogen-route protein made in Vietnam: USD 6.9 to 12.6 per kg (2030), 4.7 to 8.6 (2040), 3.3 to 6.5 (2050), against fishmeal protein at 2.6 to 3.8 and soybean-meal protein at about 0.88 per kg (2025 to 2026 prices).

label: Cost fall per doubling in fermentation industries
label_vi: Mức giảm chi phí mỗi lần sản lượng tăng gấp đôi trong ngành lên men
context: US corn ethanol 13% (1983 to 2005); Brazilian cane ethanol 19 to 20% (1975 to 2005). No observed learning rate exists for any alternative protein.

label: Cost floor for fungal feed protein on cassava glucose
label_vi: Mức giá sàn của đạm nấm làm thức ăn chăn nuôi từ glucose sắn
value: about USD 1,870 per t of protein, 2.1 times soybean-meal protein
context: Even with free capital, glucose and urea set this floor, so learning alone cannot close the gap to soybean-meal protein (USD 880 per t). Our calculation (working-papers/wave3/econ_policy/ecf_calc.py) on the chapter 9 cost stack.

label: Power needed for 1 Mt of protein from power a year
label_vi: Điện năng cần cho 1 triệu tấn đạm từ điện mỗi năm
value: 64 to 83 TWh (4 to 6% of planned 2050 supply)
context: Also 43 to 56 GW of solar or 14 to 22 GW of offshore wind, 0.69 Mt of hydrogen (3.5 to 6.9% of the 2050 hydrogen target) and 2.95 Mt of CO2. Our calculation from a published model and Vietnam's power and hydrogen plans.

label: Vietnamese share of gas-fermentation protein research
label_vi: Số công trình của Việt Nam về đạm lên men khí
context: Publications on gas- or CO2-based microbial protein, 2016 to 2026: China 105, US 64, Denmark 47, Vietnam 2.

label: Soybean-meal need in 2050 on trend
label_vi: Nhu cầu khô đậu tương năm 2050 theo xu hướng
context: Our balance model on trend diets and trend efficiency: 7.2 Mt (2025), 8.5 (2030), 10.0 (2040), 10.4 (2050), nearly all imported. Published projections stop at 2035.

label: Soybean-meal need in 2050 across four scenarios
label_vi: Khoảng nhu cầu khô đậu tương năm 2050 theo bốn kịch bản
context: S-EFF 7.0, S-ALT 8.8, S-BASE 10.4, S-HIGH 11.7 Mt. Only the efficiency scenario keeps imports at or below the 2025 level.

label: Farmland abroad used for Vietnam's imported feed
label_vi: Diện tích đất ở nước ngoài phục vụ thức ăn chăn nuôi nhập khẩu của Việt Nam
value: about 4.0 million ha (2025); 4.7 million ha (2050, trend)
context: Imported soybean meal needs about 2.3 million ha (mass allocation) and imported maize 1.6 million ha: together about five times Vietnam's own maize area. Our calculation.

label: Efficiency against alternative protein, 2050
label_vi: Hiệu quả thức ăn so với đạm thay thế, năm 2050
value: 3.4 Mt against 1.6 Mt of soybean meal saved
context: Against trend, feed conversion improving 1.0% a year (livestock) and 0.8% (aquaculture) instead of 0.4% and 0.3%, and soybean-meal inclusion falling 1% a year, save 3.4 Mt in 2050; replacing 10% of soybean-meal protein, 40% of fishmeal protein and 10% of meat demand with alternatives saves 1.6 Mt. The two add up.

label: Scale implied by the alternative-protein scenario, 2050
label_vi: Quy mô cần có theo kịch bản đạm thay thế năm 2050
context: S-ALT implies about 0.86 Mt of dry microbial feed product in 2050: about 78 times the combined design capacity of Entobel's two Vietnamese insect-meal plants (11 kt a year), or 43 plants of Calysseo's 20 kt size; about 9 times by 2030. Plus 0.29 Mt of food protein ingredient. Our arithmetic.

label: Aquafeed omega-3 need, 2050
label_vi: Nhu cầu omega-3 trong thức ăn thủy sản năm 2050
value: about 21 kt of EPA plus DHA (10 to 40 kt)
context: About 11 kt today. Vietnam's pangasius fish oil is not an omega-3 source (0.17 to 0.31% EPA plus DHA), so the need must be imported or made. Our estimate.

label: The 2030 industrial feed target covers livestock only
label_vi: Mục tiêu thức ăn công nghiệp năm 2030 chỉ tính thức ăn chăn nuôi
value: 30 to 32 Mt target against 26.4 Mt modelled
context: Decision 1625/QD-TTg sets 24 to 25 Mt of industrial livestock feed for 2025 (probably missed: about 21.5 Mt in 2024) and 30 to 32 Mt for 2030. Our model gives 26.4 Mt of livestock and poultry feed in 2030. Answers OQ-127 at Medium confidence.

label: Peruvian anchoveta, first season 2026
label_vi: Vụ cá cơm Peru đầu năm 2026
value: about 25% of a 1.9 Mt quota landed
context: The lowest quota in a decade, 36% below 2025; world fishmeal output fell 26% year on year in January to April 2026. NOAA gives over 90% odds of a very strong El Nino in winter 2026 to 2027.

label: Plays that thrive in all four 2050 worlds
label_vi: Số hướng đi thành công trong cả bốn kịch bản 2050
context: Public feed-trial capacity, a protein-quality laboratory and an open cost model and price series. Ten more plays hold in every world with conditions; two are bets; one is a research option. Our judgement.

label: Vision: soybean-meal need in 2050
label_vi: Tầm nhìn: nhu cầu khô đậu tương năm 2050
value: 7 to 9 Mt, against 10.4 Mt on trend
context: Normative goal, not a forecast: a credible ambitious range based on the efficiency and alternative-protein scenarios and on China's and Norway's achieved pace. Holding imports at 7.2 Mt is a stretch.

label: Vision: microbial protein in feed, 2050
label_vi: Tầm nhìn: tỷ lệ đạm vi sinh trong thức ăn năm 2050
context: Normative goal: about 1% by 2030, 1 to 3% by 2035, 2 to 4% by 2040. No national feed system has reached 1% novel protein; Norway was at 0.4% in 2020. The top of the range is a stretch.

label: Vision: non-marine omega-3 in aquafeed, 2050
label_vi: Tầm nhìn: omega-3 không từ biển trong thức ăn thủy sản năm 2050
context: Normative goal based on commercial algal and oilseed omega-3 oils; omega-3 canola oil has replaced all fish oil in low-fishmeal shrimp diets without growth loss.

label: Furthest horizon of any national protein plan
label_vi: Tầm xa nhất của các kế hoạch quốc gia về đạm
context: EU, Canada and Singapore stop at 2035; Japan at FY2030; China, Israel and the Netherlands at 2030. Japan's MIDORI (2050) and Denmark's land deal (2045) carry no protein indicator. One exception: a Japanese food-tech investment roadmap to 2040, reported only in the press (Low confidence).

label: No-regret moves for 2026 to 2030
label_vi: Số biện pháp không hối tiếc cho giai đoạn 2026 đến 2030
context: A protein and feed balance; feed efficiency and formulation; new-food and new-feed routes with deadlines; shared pilot and trial capacity; a quality laboratory and price series; residue-carbon rules; an omega-3 plan; climate-proof siting; process skills. Our judgement.

label: Value of cheaper capital for fermentation protein
label_vi: Giá trị của vốn rẻ hơn đối với đạm lên men
value: 12% to 9% capital charge does as much as the learning expected by 2030
unit: USD per t protein (2030 low end)
context: Cutting the annual capital charge from 12% to 9% lowers the 2030 low-end cost of fungal feed protein to about USD 3,610 per t of protein with no learning at all, close to the central learning case in 2030 (USD 3,557 after two doublings of output). Our calculation (ecf_calc.py) on the chapter 9 cost stack.
